evidence_policy: Performance budgets are exact-SHA regression gates for reconstructed runtime classes. They do not weaken or replace visual, behavioral, collision, battle, content, or device-proof gates. Historical Global performance characteristics are unresolved.

historical_global_performance.reason: No recovered Global-era performance telemetry establishes original startup, frame-time, CPU, memory, or jank targets.

chromium_ci_720x1280.measurement_source: Playwright Chromium headless against hydrated recovered field runtime; this cadence-throttled CI class is a regression detector, not a proxy for physical-device FPS.
notes: Headless CI requestAnimationFrame cadence is consistently ~66.7 ms p95 on the canonical VM and is intentionally budgeted as its own runtime class.
Physical-device frame performance is governed separately by the Samsung hardware class and remains much stricter.
CPU percentage is intentionally not a release budget from the single 10-second sample because scheduler load makes it too noisy.
Game-category A/B data is used only as a measured hardware baseline, not as historical Global evidence.
